written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Warm iff apologies minus insults is at least 1; gifts are neutral.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Track a capped grudge: insults add one, apologies remove one (never below zero), gifts do nothing; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Track an insult streak and a binary mood: gifts clear the streak, an apology warms only if the streak is under 2, and a second consecutive insult makes Robin cold.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Warm iff the first non-gift action is an apology and there is at most one insult in total.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Track a capped grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1, and a gift subtracts 1 only when the grudge is already at least 2; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Track a capped grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1, and a gift subtracts 1 only when the current grudge is even; warm iff grudge is zero.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Track a capped grudge; normally warm iff grudge is zero, but once the grudge is already 3 or more, another insult snaps Robin back to warm by resetting grudge to zero.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Track a capped grudge; normally warm iff grudge is zero, but once the grudge is already 3 or more, an apology forgives everything and resets grudge to zero.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Track a grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only when the grudge is exactly 2 or at least 5; warm iff grudge is 0.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Track a grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only when grudge modulo 4 equals 2; warm iff grudge is 0.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Track a grudge and the previous action: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only if grudge is at least 2 and the previous action was an insult; warm iff grudge is 0.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Track a grudge and the number of insults so far: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only if grudge is at least 2 and the prior insult count is even; warm iff grudge is 0.

survivors.name: round 2 rival 1
survivors.comment: Track a capped grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1, and a gift subtracts 1 only when the grudge is already at least 2; warm iff grudge is zero.

survivors.name: round 2 rival 2
survivors.comment: Track a capped grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1, and a gift subtracts 1 only when the current grudge is even; warm iff grudge is zero.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 1
survivors.comment: Track a grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only when the grudge is exactly 2 or at least 5; warm iff grudge is 0.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 2
survivors.comment: Track a grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only when grudge modulo 4 equals 2; warm iff grudge is 0.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 3
survivors.comment: Track a grudge and the previous action: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only if grudge is at least 2 and the previous action was an insult; warm iff grudge is 0.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 4
survivors.comment: Track a grudge and the number of insults so far: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1 capped at 0, and gifts subtract 1 only if grudge is at least 2 and the prior insult count is even; warm iff grudge is 0.

shown the survivors.comment: Track a capped grudge: insults add 1, apologies subtract 1, gifts subtract 1 only when grudge is at least 2; warm iff grudge is zero.

shown the facts only.comment: Hidden anger: insult +1; apologise -1 (min 0); gift -1 only if anger >= 2; mood warm iff anger is 0.
